text:
Talia: Heads-up: saw unexpected CSR activity hitting signing-service in eu-west around 2026-03-18T03:12Z. Requestor shows 'proxy-provisioner'.
Kishore: Paste subject/thumbprint and audit line?
Talia: subject=CN=svc.proxy.edge-eu, O=redwood; sha256=5d1e...; audit: `2026-03-18T03:12:05Z INFO RequestReceived uid=ac9f authn=proxy-provisioner action=create_csr region=eu-west`
opsec-bot: alert: csr-unexpected-eu-west  4 events in 90s for 'svc.proxy.edge*' (rule: ephemeral-csr-spike).
Samir: We rolled a scoped RBAC tweak at 02:45 to allow proxy-provisioner for canaries. Could be a glob mistake.
Kishore: Did CA sign any?
Talia: Two certs issued, 1h TTL.
Kishore: Immediate: revoke those certs, revert RBAC change, pull KMS:Decrypt logs for signing-key-eu-west and IAM policy delta.
Samir: Running revoke: `signingctl revoke --region eu-west --selector "subject:svc.proxy.edge*" --reason misissue`
Talia: Revoke completed  2 certs revoked. Serials: 0x7b1c...,0x7b1d...
Kishore: Forensics tasks: collect signing-service audit, KMS decrypt events, edge-proxy traces, and deploy CI test for IAM condition patterns.
Samir: Short-term hardening: server-side CN strict matching, require caller token id in CSR request, emit csr.requestor identity metric, and add auto-pause rule if >3 unexpected CSRs in 5m.
opsec-bot: incident_created: incident/7690012345  owners @samir @kishore @talia. Next update in 30m.
